q: Which actor played the penniless artist Jack Dawson in the 1997 film Titanic?
note: The film won eleven Academy Awards, tying the record set by the 1959 epic Ben-Hur.

q: In the 1999 film The Matrix, what color pill does Neo swallow to learn the truth?
note: Its slow-motion 'bullet time' shots were made with a ring of still cameras firing in sequence.

q: In the 1994 film Forrest Gump, Forrest says that life is like a box of what?
note: Tom Hanks won Best Actor for the role, his second win in a row after Philadelphia.

q: In the 1990 comedy Home Alone, what is the first name of the boy left behind when his family flies to Paris?
note: John Hughes wrote the screenplay after wondering what might happen if he forgot one of his own children on a trip.

q: In the 2001 film Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone, what is the name of the school Harry is invited to attend?
accept: Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry
note: Outside North America the same film was released as Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone.

q: Which actor played the Joker in the 2008 film The Dark Knight?
note: He died before the film opened and won a posthumous Oscar for Best Supporting Actor.

q: In the 1993 film Jurassic Park, what is the name of the island where the dinosaur park is built?
note: Michael Crichton wrote the 1990 novel and then co-wrote the screenplay.

q: Who wrote and directed the 1994 crime film Pulp Fiction?
note: It won the Palme d'Or at Cannes and the Academy Award for Best Original Screenplay.

q: In the 1994 film The Shawshank Redemption, what does Andy Dufresne hang on his cell wall to hide his escape tunnel?
note: The film barely made its money back in cinemas and became a favorite only through television reruns and video.

q: Which actor played Hannibal Lecter in the 1991 film The Silence of the Lambs?
note: The film swept the top five Oscars, something only two other films have ever managed.

q: The opening sequence of the 1998 film Saving Private Ryan re-creates the D-Day landing on which Normandy beach?
note: The landing was actually filmed on a stretch of Irish coast in County Wexford.

q: Which actor played the Roman general Maximus in the 2000 film Gladiator?
note: The film took Best Picture and Crowe took Best Actor.

q: In the 2001 film The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring, which hobbit is given the task of carrying the One Ring?
note: Peter Jackson shot all three installments back to back in New Zealand.

q: On which lush alien moon is the 2009 film Avatar set?
note: Pandora is a moon orbiting a gas giant, not a planet in its own right.

q: What is the name of the hidden African nation ruled by T'Challa in the 2018 film Black Panther?
note: It became the first superhero film ever nominated for the Best Picture Oscar.

q: Which 2016 musical was mistakenly announced as the Best Picture winner before Moonlight was named the real winner?
note: The presenters had been handed a duplicate Best Actress envelope, which Emma Stone had just won for that same film.

q: In Steven Spielberg's otherwise black-and-white 1993 film Schindler's List, what color is the coat worn by a small girl in the ghetto?
note: The film won Spielberg his first Academy Award for Best Director.

q: Which pair of filmmaking brothers wrote and directed the 2007 Best Picture winner No Country for Old Men?
note: Javier Bardem won Best Supporting Actor as the coin-flipping killer Anton Chigurh.

q: Which 2000 Christopher Nolan thriller tells the story of a man with no short-term memory largely in reverse order?
note: It grew out of a short story written by the director's brother, Jonathan Nolan.

q: Which comedian wrote and directed the 2017 horror film Get Out, winning an Oscar for its screenplay?
note: He was already well known for the sketch series Key & Peele.
